title: A site brief names no CMS or template: one brief of a research feeds demos on any CMS and template, the build freezes its choice, one live build per (brief, choice), and collected data still wins over sample content
steps: S1: buildBrief on a full research read; validateBrief on it; briefForBuild of it for one CMS and template.
S2: makeBuildChoice and withBuildChoice for one build of a brief; choiceKey of two choices.
S3: through the doors, the same research asked twice for a brief, then a Settings change, then a new build.
S4: a second demo action with the same CMS and template while the first build is live.
S5: buildBrief on a research that collected some dishes, reviews and a rating, and lacks the rest.
expect: S1: the brief is valid and holds no cms, cmsSource, resolvedAt or template; the build's view carries them and is valid.
S2: the choice carries CMS, template, workflow and the acceptance lines naming them; the stored brief is untouched; the key differs only on what makes two demos different.
S3: the same research answers the same brief; the Settings change reaches only the next build.
S4: refused BUILD_EXISTS before any charge.
S5: acceptance says collected prices, dishes, reviews and ratings are shown as held and sample content only fills what was not collected.
fence: briefForBuild and validateBrief's optional cms/template, makeBuildChoice/withBuildChoice/choiceKey, revisionForAction's reuse by research_hash, liveBuildOf keyed on (revision, choice_key)

tests: a full brief is valid and names no CMS or template: one brief serves every build
a brief seen from a build carries the build’s CMS and template, and is valid
what the research did not collect is left to sample content, a suggestion for the owner; collected data wins
a choice carries the CMS, the template, the workflow and the lines that name them, frozen with the build
a revision read for one build looks as a revision with a template did; the stored brief stays untouched
the build key names what makes two demos of one brief different, and nothing that does not
a brief is a research snapshot: the same research answers it again, and a Settings change only reaches the next build
build: one live demo per (brief, choice) — the same CMS and template again is refused BUILD_EXISTS before any charge
